visualCharacteristics: White background tabbed testimonial component. A row of selectable person cards (avatar + name + role) switches an active panel showing a large portrait, name, role and quote.
contentPattern: Each row = [tab label cell (person avatar/name/role) | panel cell (portrait image + name + role + quote)]. First row is active by default.
usage: Switchable testimonial/quote panels driven by a person-based tab menu.
